```{r Load}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)


# pollen data
pollen_samples <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Pollen_samples_data_cleaned.csv')

# nest-level data summary
beehav_sum <- read_csv('Data/Behaviour/Behaviour_nest_summary_cleaned.csv')

# nest-level data all social statuses
beehav_full <- read_csv('Data/Behaviour/Behaviour_nest_full_cleaned.csv')

# pollen_samples and behaviour data
pollen_beehav <- read_csv('Data/Behaviour/Pollen_and_behaviour_cleaned.csv')

# pollen richness for individuals  
pollen_beehav_ind <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Pollen_richness_individuals_cleaned.csv')

# pollen richness for nests  
pollen_beehav_nest <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Pollen_richness_nests_cleaned.csv')

# pollen and abundance data
pollen_samples_abundance <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Pollen_samples_abundance_cleaned.csv')

# abundance data
abundance_for_fig <- read_csv('Data/Pollen_and_Surveys/Abundance_50m_for_figure_cleaned.csv') 


# set theme
theme_set(theme_classic())



```

```{r Pollen_figures}

 library(ggh4x) # facet wrap 2


# make date labels for the figure
pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>%
  mutate(
    Date_label  = format(Date_pollen, "%b %d"),                    
    Date_label  = factor(Date_label, levels = format(sort(unique(Date_pollen)), "%b %d")))


# order by first date of bee sample
level_order <- pollen_samples %>%
  distinct(Site, Num_ID, Date_pollen) %>%
  slice_min(Date_pollen, by = Num_ID) %>%
  arrange(Site == "KB", Date_pollen) %>%  # FALSE sorts before TRUE, so non-KB first
  pull(Num_ID)

pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>%
  mutate(Num_ID = factor(Num_ID, levels = level_order))

pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>%
  arrange(Num_ID, Date_pollen) %>%
  mutate(Slide_code = factor(Slide_code, levels = unique(Slide_code)))


# # take the order of bee IDs and divided them by 10s

# what's the order of the most collected pollen?
pollen_samples %>% 
  group_by(Subtype) %>% 
  summarise(count = sum(Count_scaled)) %>%

## Text for legend

library(ggtext)

pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>%
  mutate(Subtype_label = case_when(
#    Subtype == "Ranunculus" ~ "<i>Ranunculus</i> (Ranunculaceae)",
    Subtype == "Rubus" ~ "<i>Rubus</i> (Rosaceae)",
    Subtype == "Veronica" ~ "<i>Veronica</i> (Plantaginaceae)",
    Subtype == "Cichorieae" ~ "Cichorieae (Asteraceae)",
#    Subtype == "Corokia" ~ "<i>Corokia</i> (Argophyllaceae)",
#    Subtype == "Leycesteria" ~ "<i>Leycesteria</i> (Caprifoliaceae)",
#    Subtype == "Lysimachia" ~ "<i>Lysimachia</i> (Primulaceae)",
#    Subtype == "Muehlenbeckia" ~ "<i>Muehlenbeckia</i> (Polygonaceae)",    
    Subtype == "Plantago" ~ "<i>Plantago</i> (Plantaginaceae)",
    Subtype == "Pyracantha" ~ "<i>Pyracantha</i> (Rosaceae)",
#    Subtype == "Rhododendron" ~ "<i>Rhododendron</i> (Ericaceae)",
#    Subtype == "Solanum" ~ "<i>Solanum</i> (Solanaceae)",    
#    Subtype == "Viburnum" ~ "<i>Viburnum</i> (Adoxaceae)",
    Subtype == 'Unknown_1' ~ 'Type 1',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_2' ~ 'Type 2',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_3' ~ 'Type 3',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_4' ~ 'Type 4',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_5' ~ 'Type 5',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_6' ~ 'Type 6',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_7' ~ 'Type 7',
    TRUE ~ Subtype  # leave the rest as is
  ))


# choose order of legend
pollen_samples <- pollen_samples %>%
  mutate(Subtype = factor(Subtype, levels = c(
    'Amaryllidaceae',
    'Asteraceae',
    'Cichorieae',
    'Brassicaceae',
    'Caryophyllaceae', 
    'Corokia',
    'Iridaceae',       
    'Leycesteria',     
    'Lysimachia',      
    'Muehlenbeckia',   
    'Myrtaceae',       
    'Plantago',  
    'Veronica',    
    'Poaceae',         
    'Ranunculus',   
    'Rhododendron',    
    'Rosaceae',
    'Rubus',   
    'Pyracantha',
    'Solanum', 
    'Viburnum',        
    'Unknown_1',       
    'Unknown_2',       
    'Unknown_3',      
    'Unknown_4',       
    'Unknown_5',       
    'Unknown_6',       
    'Unknown_7'
    )))


# plot with facat wrap

samples_fig <- pollen_samples %>%
  arrange(Num_ID, Date_pollen) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Slide_code, y = Count, fill = Subtype)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.8) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Proportion of pollen sample") +
  facet_wrap2(~ Num_ID, scales = "free_x", ncol = 10) +
 scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) {
   pollen_samples$Date_label[match(x, pollen_samples$Slide_code)]
 }) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = specific_colours,
  labels = pollen_samples %>% distinct(Subtype, Subtype_label) %>% deframe()
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.6, size = 7, colour = "grey20"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey70", hjust = 0),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20"), # make ticks thinner
    legend.text = element_markdown(),   
    axis.line.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20"), # make lines thinner
    axis.line.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "grey20")
    ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) + # breaks 
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) # make legend one column instead of two
  
  
samples_fig


## Save
ggsave('Figures/Pollen_samples_fig.png', samples_fig, width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 300)

```

```{r Abundance_figures}


## Abundance



# # do both sites have identical taxa? I can only have one legend
# JAM <- abundance_for_fig %>% 
#   filter(Site == 'JAM') %>% 
#   select(Subtype)
# KB <- abundance_for_fig %>% 
#   filter(Site == 'KB') %>% 
#   select(Subtype)
# anti_join(KB, JAM) # has rhododendron and muehlenbeckia
# anti_join(JAM, KB)


# jitter the lines becasue some overlap
pos <- position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.1)


# plot for JAM
abund_fig_JAM <- abundance_for_fig %>% 
  filter(Site == 'JAM') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Season, y = Abundance_for50, group = Subtype, colour = Subtype)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.05, height = 0.05) +
  geom_line(position = pos, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = specific_colours) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")


# plot for KB
abund_fig_KB <- abundance_for_fig %>% 
  filter(Site == 'KB') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Season, y = Abundance_for50, group = Subtype, colour = Subtype)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.7, width = 0.05, height = 0.05) +
  geom_line(position = pos, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = specific_colours) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# order for the legend
abundance_for_fig <- abundance_for_fig %>%
  mutate(Subtype = factor(Subtype, levels = c(
    'Amaryllidaceae',
    'Asteraceae',
    'Cichorieae',
    'Brassicaceae',
    'Caryophyllaceae', 
    'Corokia',
    'Iridaceae',       
    'Leycesteria',     
    'Lysimachia',      
    'Muehlenbeckia',   
    'Myrtaceae',       
    'Plantago',  
    'Veronica',    
    'Poaceae',         
    'Ranunculus',   
    'Rhododendron',    
    'Rosaceae',
    'Rubus',   
    'Pyracantha',
    'Solanum', 
    'Viburnum'
    )))

# text for the legend ####### didnt work for this label 
abundance_for_fig <- abundance_for_fig %>%
  mutate(Subtype_label = case_when(
#    Subtype == "Ranunculus" ~ "<i>Ranunculus</i> (Ranunculaceae)",
    Subtype == "Rubus" ~ "<i>Rubus</i> (Rosaceae)",
    Subtype == "Veronica" ~ "<i>Veronica</i> (Plantaginaceae)",
    Subtype == "Cichorieae" ~ "Cichorieae (Asteraceae)",
#    Subtype == "Corokia" ~ "<i>Corokia</i> (Argophyllaceae)",
#    Subtype == "Leycesteria" ~ "<i>Leycesteria</i> (Caprifoliaceae)",
#    Subtype == "Lysimachia" ~ "<i>Lysimachia</i> (Primulaceae)",
#    Subtype == "Muehlenbeckia" ~ "<i>Muehlenbeckia</i> (Polygonaceae)",    
    Subtype == "Plantago" ~ "<i>Plantago</i> (Plantaginaceae)",
    Subtype == "Pyracantha" ~ "<i>Pyracantha</i> (Rosaceae)",
#    Subtype == "Rhododendron" ~ "<i>Rhododendron</i> (Ericaceae)",
#    Subtype == "Solanum" ~ "<i>Solanum</i> (Solanaceae)",    
#    Subtype == "Viburnum" ~ "<i>Viburnum</i> (Adoxaceae)",
    Subtype == 'Unknown_1' ~ 'Type 1',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_2' ~ 'Type 2',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_3' ~ 'Type 3',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_4' ~ 'Type 4',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_5' ~ 'Type 5',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_6' ~ 'Type 6',
    Subtype == 'Unknown_7' ~ 'Type 7',
    TRUE ~ Subtype  # leave the rest as is
  ))


# I want a single legend with ALL taxa combined, so create a dummy plot to extract legend 
all_taxa <- unique(abundance_for_fig$Subtype_label)
dummy_plot <- data.frame(
  Subtype_label = all_taxa,
  x = 1,
  y = 1
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, colour = Subtype_label)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = specific_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# extract legend 
legend <- get_legend(dummy_plot)


## Combine figs

# combine, add letters and legend
abund_combined <- plot_grid(
  plot_grid(abund_fig_JAM, abund_fig_KB,
            ncol = 2, labels = c("A", "B"),
            label_fontface = "plain",  # not bold
            label_x = -0.02),          # move letters slightly left 
  legend,
  ncol = 2,
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.2)) # legend width


# make axes labels
abund_left_label <- ggplot() +
  annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5, # x is left or right, y is up and down
           label = 'Abundance',
           angle = 90,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )
abund_bottom_label <- ggplot() +
    annotate('text',
           x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
           label = 'Season',
           angle = 0,
           size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

# combine them into a single plot object
abund_combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(abund_left_label, abund_combined, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(0.05, 0.95))
abund_combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(abund_combined, abund_bottom_label, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.09))

abund_combined



```

```{r Pollen_figs_2}
 

# pollen_samples types bees collected, summary 
# first make df for the sample size for above figures
n_df_KB <- pollen_samples %>%
  filter(Site == 'KB') %>% 
  group_by(Date_label) %>%
  summarise(N_bees = length(unique(Slide_code))) 

n_df_JAM <- pollen_samples %>%
  filter(Site == 'JAM') %>% 
  group_by(Date_label) %>%
  summarise(N_bees = length(unique(Slide_code))) 

pollen_samples %>% 
  filter(Site == 'KB') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Date_label, y = Count, fill = Family)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  geom_text(
    data = n_df_KB,
    aes(x = Date_label, y = 1.05, label = (N_bees)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.1)) + 
  labs(y = 'Proportion of pollen', x = 'Date') + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,  vjust = 0.6))
  
pollen_samples %>% 
  filter(Site == 'JAM') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Date_label, y = Count, fill = Family)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  geom_text(
    data = n_df_JAM,
    aes(x = Date_label, y = 1.05, label = (N_bees)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1.1)) + 
  labs(y = 'Proportion of pollen', x = 'Date') + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,  vjust = 0.6))



# abundance for 50m
pollen_samples_abundance %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Abundance_for50) & Count_scaled != 0) %>% 
  group_by(Slide_code) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Abundance_for50, y = Count_scaled)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity")

# abundance for 200m
pollen_samples_abundance %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Abundance_for200) & Count_scaled != 0) %>% 
  group_by(Slide_code) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Abundance_for200, y = Count_scaled)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity")
```

```{r Behviour_figures}

# label by week

beehav_full <- beehav_full %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date_beehav)) %>% 
  mutate(Week_index = as.numeric(difftime(floor_date(Date_beehav, "week"),
                                     floor_date(min(Date_beehav), "week"),
                                     units = "weeks") + 1))

# remove duplicates within the same week if there are any by arranging "social" first, then removing dupes
beehav_sum_weekly <- beehav_full %>%
  group_by(Week_index, Nest) %>%
  arrange(desc(Num_females_same_day)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()


# plot nest socialty throughout the season 

# make sample size for figure
sample_size_beehav_full <- beehav_sum_weekly %>%
  count(Week_index)


# con
beehav_sum_weekly %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Week_index, fill = Social_status_con)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(y = "Percent") +
  geom_text(data = sample_size_beehav_full,
            aes(x = Week_index, y = 1.05,
                label = paste0(n)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#045b87", "#52c5ff"))



# max number of females in each nest 
# Conservative estimate
beehav_sum %>%
  filter(Num_females_same_day != 0) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Num_females_same_day, fill = Site)) +
  geom_bar(position = 'dodge') +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#e65f55", "#edc647"))  +
  labs(y = 'Number of nests', x = 'Number of females')



# Number females over time in social nests conservative estimate
beehav_sum_weekly %>%
  filter(Nest == "J18" | Nest == "J100" | Nest == "J87" | Nest == "J91" | Nest == "J92" | Nest == "K13") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Week_index, y = Num_females_same_day, colour = Nest, fill = Nest)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  ylim(0, 4)


# plot total number of nest sociality
beehav_sum %>%
  filter(Num_females_same_day != 0) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Site, fill = Social_status_con)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#045b87", "#52c5ff")) +
  labs(fill = "Sociality", y = 'Number of nests')
```
